reflections.title: A country makes the four-day work week law
reflections.statement: Parliament passes a law that cuts the standard work week from five days to four, with no cut in pay. Employers get two years to adjust, and overtime will start after 32 hours. Hospitals, shops and factories that must stay open will need new shift patterns.

reflections.title: A town replaces its weekly street market with a permanent covered hall
reflections.statement: For forty years the market filled the high street every Saturday and was packed away by evening. The council has voted to build a covered hall with fixed stalls, open six days a week. The street will be returned to traffic.
